reasoning: Every element of the canonical 1/2/2 key is derivable from the standalone stem plus general nursing/pharmacology knowledge, and inspection of the sibling case confirms that none of the missing client facts catalogued in the immutable standalone-unblinding record is necessary to reach or defend that key. The condition (C2) is fixed by the stem's own boggy-uterus finding and its explicit exclusion of retained fragments and cervical/vaginal lacerations; the sibling's q2 reaches the identical conclusion using the same cue, which is corroboration, not supply. A2 rests on the stem's statement that tone is lost within seconds of massage. A4 rests on the stem's explicitly stated pregnancy-induced hypertension, which contraindicates the only competing drug token (A1); the sibling's q3 adds carboprost and the asthma contraindication, but carboprost is absent from the standalone pool, so that added fact is not needed. P3 and P1 are anchored by the stem's boggy fundus and its explicit QBL of 1,200 mL. The sibling data that the standalone record listed as missing — oxytocin dosing (20 units/1 L LR, ~50 min), coagulation panel and H/H (Hgb 8.1, fibrinogen 280, INR 1.1), two 16-gauge IVs and type-and-crossmatch, the TXA protocol order, bladder distention with 450 mL catheterized during Stage 1, the fundus-palpable inversion rule-out, and the negative bleeding-disorder history — all either confirm exclusions the standalone already secured on other grounds or pertain to tokens not present in the standalone pools. No keyed token depends on an absent fact, no distractor becomes defensible with the sibling in hand, and no unstated fact reverses the ranking, so no FAIL tier is triggered and there is no reviewer disagreement to hold.

scopeCollateral.location: standalone item — stem clause 'and mild intermittent asthma'
scopeCollateral.observation: This comorbidity is carried over from the sibling, where it is decision-critical because carboprost is an available option. In the standalone pool it is non-discriminating context. It does not mislead — misoprostol remains correct and asthma-safe — but a learner may search for an asthma-driven exclusion that no token supplies. Advisory only; no content edit proposed.

scopeCollateral.location: standalone item — stem clause 'no retained placental fragments'
scopeCollateral.observation: The stem pre-resolves retained tissue in text, whereas the sibling makes it a live distractor (dd_condition_retained). The standalone therefore narrows the differential before the learner engages it. This is appropriate for a self-contained bowtie item and is what makes C2 uniquely defensible without exhibits, but it does reduce the differential-diagnosis work relative to the sibling.

The strategy text ('lock the condition to the most decisive cue first... Here the decisive cue is uterine tone') is generic to bowtie items and references no exhibit, stage, or sibling question. It parallels the sibling's case-level four-T guidance without depending on it. No scope leakage.

The sibling's q4 keys five concurrent actions (massage, uterotonic, fluids, TXA, crossmatch); the standalone pool offers only two of these concepts plus two distractors, forcing exactly the two the canonical key selects. The reduction is a deliberate and internally consistent scope narrowing, not an omission that makes the standalone unanswerable — the Stage 1 free-generation record's broader resuscitation package simply has no tokens to map onto.

secondaryFlags: Blind Stage 1 free generation, blind Stage 2 token selection, and the canonical key are in full agreement; the sibling case independently reaches the same condition (q2), the same uterotonic (q3), the same compression action (q4), and the same two response parameters (q5 rows row_firm_uterus and row_qbl_plateau), so there is no key-versus-reasoning conflict at any layer.

The standalone item and the sibling Stage 2 exhibit share identical clinical values (QBL 1,200 mL, HR 132, BP 80/52, confusion, pallor, uterus firming then relaxing within seconds, provider rule-out of retained fragments and unrepaired lacerations), indicating the standalone was derived from that exhibit without introducing conflicting data.

Two standalone distractors (C1, P4) are excluded on absence of data rather than contradiction; the sibling supplies the data (fibrinogen 280 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL) and it confirms rather than reverses both exclusions, so the absence-based reasoning in the immutable record was sound.

No standalone token, stem sentence, rationale, or strategy text references an exhibit, stage, prior question, or any artifact that exists only in the sibling case; the item reads as fully self-contained.
